instruction: A factory produces 1000 candies and packs them into bags of exactly 7 candies each. After packing as many full bags as possible, how many candies are left unpacked? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
